title: MLE vs MAP
interviewAnswer: Maximum likelihood chooses parameters that make observed data most likely. MAP adds a prior and chooses the most probable parameters after combining prior and likelihood; many regularizers can be interpreted as MAP priors.
why: MLE and MAP connect probability, optimization and regularization. They help explain why familiar losses such as cross-entropy and squared error arise from probabilistic assumptions.
intuition: MLE asks which parameters make the observed data most plausible. MAP asks the same question but also incorporates what parameter values were plausible before seeing the data.
deepDive: Given independent observations, MLE maximizes the likelihood or equivalently the log-likelihood. MAP maximizes log likelihood plus log prior. A Gaussian prior over weights produces an L2-style penalty; a Laplace prior produces an L1-style penalty. MLE and MAP return point estimates, unlike full Bayesian inference which maintains a posterior distribution.
math:
MLE: θ̂ = argmax_θ p(D|θ)
MAP: θ̂ = argmax_θ p(D|θ)p(θ) = argmax [log p(D|θ)+log p(θ)]
workedExample: Linear regression with Gaussian observation noise leads to minimizing squared error. Adding a zero-mean Gaussian prior on coefficients produces an L2-regularized objective, giving a MAP interpretation of ridge regression.
code:
# Negative log-likelihood + L2 prior (schematic)
loss = data_negative_log_likelihood + lambda_ * (weights**2).sum()
commonMistakes: Calling the likelihood a probability distribution over parameters.
Saying MAP is full Bayesian inference.
Assuming regularization always corresponds to the same prior regardless of formulation.
followUps: Why do we maximize log-likelihood instead of likelihood?
How does ridge regression connect to a Gaussian prior?
What is the difference between MAP and posterior mean?
When does the prior matter less?
production: Probabilistic objectives make uncertainty assumptions explicit. If noise characteristics or class probabilities shift, likelihood-based training assumptions and calibration can become wrong.
